description: Provides information about the TADS Service Instance
title: Service

name.description: The Service Instance name. This should be a very short, human-readable name that may be displayed in listings of Service Instances.

description.description: The Service Instance description. This should be a human-readable description that may be displayed in detailed views of Service Instances. The description should be longer and more detailed than `name`.

type.description: The type identifier for the Service Instance. The value must start with 'urn:x-tads:service'

api_version.description: The version of the TADS API specification this Service Instance implements

service_version.description: The version of software providing this service. Note: Different implementations and software houses may use different conventions for their version identification. As such, this field is intentionally permissive and intended to be informative only. Client Implementations should avoid using this field to determine compatibility.
